summary: Frontend-only testing for Onwan 3 enhancements: (1) Map popup status colors + click-to-details, (2) Role-based header dropdown, (3) Premium/Premium+ featured ribbons & sorting. Features 1 & 3 PASS fully. Feature 2 has a CRITICAL role-key mismatch bug: the dropdown only renders the 4 common items (favorites/notifications/settings/logout) for newly registered broker/owner/photographer users; the role-specific items never render. Admin role works because its key matches.

ui_bugs.issue: Role-key mismatch across 3 layers causes role-specific dropdown items to never render for new users. Auth step sends selectedRole values 'owner', 'broker_individual', 'broker_corporate', 'photographer', 'visitor' (App.js lines 2347-2391 -> sent as user_type at line 2171). USER_TYPES (line 30) has keys: property_owner, broker_individual, broker_company, photographer, admin. ROLE_ITEMS (line 604) has DIFFERENT keys: individual_broker, company_broker, property_owner, photographer, admin. DASHBOARD_ROLES (line 2654) uses yet another set: ['admin','individual_broker','company_broker'].
After selecting 'مالك عقار' on signup, the badge shows fallback 'مستخدم' instead of 'مالك عقار' because user_type is saved as 'owner' (not 'property_owner').

Badge correctly shows 'وسيط عقاري - فرد' (so user_type='broker_individual') but the dropdown shows NO broker-specific items (no broker-dashboard, my-properties, add-property, contracts, subscription). Reason: ROLE_ITEMS uses key 'individual_broker' instead of 'broker_individual'.
Even after fixing the key, DASHBOARD_ROLES = ['admin','individual_broker','company_broker'] will not match user_type='broker_individual'/'broker_corporate'. Broker dashboard view will not open.

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end flow fails for individual_broker / property_owner: dropdown opens but contains no role-specific actions, so 'لوحة تحكم الوسيط' / 'عقاراتي' / 'إضافة عقار' / 'عقودي' / 'الاشتراك' (broker) and 'عقاراتي' / 'إضافة عقار للبيع/الإيجار' / 'إحصائيات الإعلانات' (owner) are unreachable from the new header menu.

action_items: Unify role keys across the codebase. Recommended canonical set matching backend USER_TYPES: visitor, property_owner, broker_individual, broker_company, photographer, admin.
Fix role-selection submit (App.js ~2347-2391): map button states to canonical keys -> 'owner' should be 'property_owner', 'broker_corporate' should be 'broker_company'.
Fix DASHBOARD_ROLES (App.js ~2654): use ['admin','broker_individual','broker_company'] to allow brokers to open the dashboard.
Verify backend /api/auth/verify-otp accepts and persists the canonical user_type values; current admin seed already uses 'admin' which matches.
After fixes, retest broker dropdown opens AdminDashboard, and property_owner dropdown shows my-properties/add-property/stats (no admin/broker dashboard).
critical_code_review_comments: Three different naming conventions for the same enum (selectedRole vs USER_TYPES vs ROLE_ITEMS/DASHBOARD_ROLES). Extract a single constants module for user_type and import everywhere.
The badge fallback 'مستخدم' masks the real bug (unknown user_type). Consider asserting user_type is one of known values at login time and logging a warning.
Map popup, status colors, premium/premium+ ribbons and sort logic (FEATURED_RANK) are implemented correctly and ship-ready.
test_credentials: Phone 0500000000 is the seeded ADMIN. Use a NEW phone (e.g. 0511111111) to register as broker/owner. OTP is shown in .dev-otp-code on the OTP step.
seed_data_creation: Created two test users during run: 0511111111 (broker_individual), 0522222222 (owner). These remain in the dev DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 1 (map popup) and Feature 3 (premium/premium+ ribbons + sorting premium_plus to top) are verified working. Premium ribbon count=6, Premium+ count=4 (some duplicated across carousels - id 1 & 6). First card in DOM is property-card-1 (premium_plus). Popup .popup-status.for-sale background is red gradient as specified, details button opens the property details modal. Feature 2: the user-menu-trigger and the dropdown panel render correctly with all data-testid hooks, but the conditional ROLE_ITEMS[userType] returns undefined for newly registered users due to role-key mismatch (selectedRole / user_type / ROLE_ITEMS keys are inconsistent). Once role keys are aligned, the broker-dashboard and other role-specific items will appear.
rca of the issue: RCA Feature 2: (1) On role-selection step App.js line 2347 button sets selectedRole='owner', line 2359 sets 'broker_individual', line 2371 sets 'broker_corporate'. (2) verifyOTP posts user_type: selectedRole (line 2171) so backend stores user.user_type='owner' or 'broker_individual' etc. (3) Header badge USER_TYPES (line 30) maps broker_individual->'وسيط عقاري - فرد' (works) but has NO 'owner' key (falls back to 'مستخدم'). (4) RoleMenu ROLE_ITEMS (line 604) is keyed by 'individual_broker'/'company_broker'/'property_owner' - none match the stored user_type for new accounts, so ROLE_ITEMS[userType] = undefined and only COMMON_ITEMS render. (5) DASHBOARD_ROLES at line 2654 also uses 'individual_broker' so brokers cannot open the AdminDashboard even if the menu item rendered. Reproduction: login with a new phone, choose any non-admin role, open user-menu-trigger -> only 4 common items appear. Mitigation: align all enums to a single canonical key set as listed in action_items.
